⚡ Tired of circling for Superchargers while thousands of CCS1 stations sit open nearby?

The Brightvolt Tempest Plug — the FIRST UL certified adapter from the charging shop North American drivers trust most, unlocking 20,000+ CCS1 fast chargers for your Halcyon and NACS vehicle.

✅ First UL2252/CSA certified CCS1 to NACS adapter — safety you can measure

✅ Works with NACS/Halcyon EVs

✅ Twin temperature sensors stop overheating

✅ Locks in place — deters theft

✅ Up to 500A through liquid-cooled cables

✅ IP67 waterproof + hard case

🚗 Stop limiting where you can plug in.

👉 FREE express shipping** + save with code VOLTUP!
